verdict.rationale: Live probes show Twilio serves an llms.txt at twilio.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a machine-readable markdown version of the Video docs at /docs/video.md (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs that cover this product. The llms.txt is site-wide rather than Video-specific, and the only evidence is the probes, with no first-party documentation of these agent-facing resources. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the llms.txt/markdown docs offering, confirmation that the llms.txt indexes Video content specifically, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
